title: Player checks in at the kiosk
description: At the club check-in kiosk, a member finds their row, enters their score PIN, and joins today’s attendance.

steps.title: Check-in kiosk
steps.body: The front desk leaves the Players list in check-in kiosk mode. Members use the Check-in control on their row — not a personal login.

steps.title: Find your name
steps.body: Eden Brooks has an active visit pack and is not present yet, so their row shows Check-in.

steps.title: Start check-in
steps.body: Tap Check-in on your row. The kiosk asks for your score PIN (not your login password).

steps.title: PIN prompt
steps.body: The dialog names the member and asks for the PIN configured on their profile.

steps.title: Enter PIN and confirm
steps.body: Type the PIN, then confirm Check-in. A correct PIN records attendance for today.
steps.actionHint: Click Check-in after entering the PIN

steps.title: Checked in
steps.body: Attendance updates: the member is present, the row switches to Check-out, and visit-pack remaining visits decrease when this was a charged check-in.
steps.resultNote: PIN accepted; member is in today’s present list.
